reason: brief P2j. the interpolation method writes the same curve type into curve_type[0..2] (interpolator_callback, src/iop/rgbcurve.c) and is shown from curve_type[0] (gui_update). Brief P3c: the two pickers next to the channel tabs. "create curve" sets the channel's nodes from the picked area (module action set_nodes_from_area; rgbcurve.c color_picker_apply), on the channel of the selected tab (tabs shown only with independent channels, rgbcurve.c _rgbcurve_show_hide_controls; back to R otherwise). "show color" marks the picked values on desktop's graph; without the graph the app shows them in the line under the photo.
